race.comment: PACKERS JOURNEY (2) is coming off a tough win at Mildura, sent out a $3 favourite and proving too strong in the finish. This doesn't look any harder and she gets every hope from a good draw. Go close again. SECRET HELL (4) struggled at Ballarat Synthetic last time out but had been going well prior and back to 1100m on turf will suit much better. Respecting the Allen/Dabernig yard from the soft gate. SIMPLY SASSY (12) ran a solid race first up at Geelong despite going under as favourite and is expected to come on from that. She should be fitter and maps for a nice run. MAKARIM (3) resumes having gone to the paddock a maiden winner at Horsham. He's lightly raced and can pick up where he left off. KENTAHTEN (1) next best.
